messages.text: BL-1738 🎵 in progress — Fifteen acceptance features are red on main, 47 scenarios. Fourteen fail on BL-1517's refusal (operator_runtime.bb refuses a project root outside a git checkout since 3252212a66, 2026-09-22) because their step handlers build fixture roots with a bare mkdtemp. BL-325's handler calls mkSocketFixtureRoot outside the scope that required it. Fix: one shared step-library helper builds an isolated git-checkout fixture root, every one of the fourteen handlers uses it, and BL-325's reference is fixed
